verdict.rationale: Increase is a banking API, so user-configurable background automations (scheduled or recurring transfers, rules-based sweeps) are a fair axis for this product. The evidence shows only developer building blocks: webhooks that let your own application act automatically, real-time decision webhooks your servers answer, and API calls to sweep funds programmatically. Automatic reconciliation via unique Account Numbers is an adjacent built-in behavior, not an automation the user sets up. No first-party scheduling, recurring-transfer or rules-engine capability is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
